correctness.rationale: Theorem 4 of Chen–Li–Zhang supplies the global-center domain, with restoring positivity and even integrated damping verified for the exact normalized vector field. Analytic reversibility of the periodic annulus yields an even analytic period in amplitude. The rational Fourier homological recurrence through degree four has been recomputed and its resonances vanish with the displayed exact omega coefficients, yielding the strict balance-surface coefficient -5/16. With u=A² and mu=b²-9a, the derivative is mu/24-5u/8+O(mu*u+u²), so a unique positive simple root u=mu/15+O(mu²) exists for mu>0 and none for mu<=0; the height is 2pi+pi*mu²/360+O(mu³). Original-time rescaling gives limiting X+X^5=0 and a transverse-return argument, proving the beta constant and global-max existence when mu>0. A replayable SymPy checker independently confirms all finite identities but is not substituted for convergence arguments.

value.rationale: The coefficient surface b²=9a is singled out by exact modified-Emden cubic isochronicity, not an arbitrary numerical slice. The added quintic restoring term breaks that cancellation by a strictly negative universal fourth-order period coefficient and produces a quantitatively sharp codimension-one local maximum. The branch amplitude, excess period and global large-amplitude scaling describe an observable property of an existing complete center classification. They give a natural bifurcation phenomenon that is not a mere rewording of known global-center membership or an isolated coefficient check.
